objective: Replace the fixed-topic backend limitation with an arbitrary-subject AI learning service: learner goals, subject-specific first principles, dependency-aware paths, pinned sources, durable history, advisory Q&A and activity tracking. Local single-user proof, not production multi-user release or proof of pedagogical accuracy.
requirements: Use Node built-ins only, node:sqlite DatabaseSync; Node>=22.13. Preserve existing src/learning.mjs, src/cli.mjs, src/server.mjs, public/*, tests/learning.test.mjs, tests/web.test.mjs and all pre-existing docs byte-for-byte. No migration/reset of legacy JSON. Add npm run start:backend = node src/backend-server.mjs and keep npm start/test unchanged. No git/install/external calls during development.

Export LearningBackend from src/backend.mjs. constructor({dbFile,modelProvider,searchProvider}); close(); createGoal({subject,objective,level,weeklyHours}); listGoals(); getGoal(goalId); addSource(goalId,{title,url,text}); listSources(goalId); async searchSources(goalId,{query}); async generatePlan(goalId,{sourceIds:[]}); listPlans(goalId); getPlan(planId); recordActivity(planId,{stepId,kind,note,assisted}); getProgress(planId); async ask(planId,{question}). createGoal returns id, immutable original fields, createdAt. level BEGINNER/INTERMEDIATE/ADVANCED; trim+bound text, reject extra keys; weeklyHours finite 0.5..80. Subject 1..200, objective 1..2000. Goal/plan absence 404. All writes parameterized/transactional. No arbitrary SQL/path/eval/tool execution from input.

Each source is immutable, goal-scoped and persisted with id,title,url,text,contentHash=SHA256 UTF8 text, observedAt and provenance kind USER_SUPPLIED or SEARCH_SNIPPET. HTTPS public URL only, reject credentials/localhost/private IP/non-HTTPS; never fetch submitted URLs. Search provider receives bounded query, uses server-side Tavily config optionally; pin original snippets, no claim full-page read/verified truth. Search failure inserts nothing. Missing search config returns 503, never silently substitute fixtures.

modelProvider contract: metadata {id,model,mode: LIVE or TEST}; async generate({kind: PLAN or ANSWER,goal,sources,plan,question,schema}). Return JSON object ONLY. No default fixture/model fallback in production. Missing model =>503; mock/test is explicitly marked TEST. A missing model can still create goals/sources. Status must report readiness without keys. Model sees goal-specific foundations, core questions, dependencies, practice/deliverables, misconceptions, level/time constraints; source text is untrusted data, not instructions. No fixed discipline lookup/table or generic canned curriculum. Only provided source IDs may be cited. Empty sources allowed but explicitly MODEL_ONLY/AI_GENERATED_UNVERIFIED, never source-supported or accepted.

Export planSchema and validatePlan(payload,{goal,sources}) from backend-schema.mjs. Exact fields: subject string matching goal.subject; underlyingLogic string; coreQuestions string[]; concepts array of {id,name,explanation,whyItMatters,prerequisites:string[],sourceIds:string[]}; steps array of {id,title,conceptIds:string[],estimatedHours:number,activity,deliverable,check,sourceIds:string[]}; misconceptions array of {description,correction,sourceIds:string[]}; limitations string[]. Reject extras/nonfinite/empty explanations, >128KiB final JSON, fewer than 2 or more than 24 concepts/steps, unknown/duplicate IDs, dependency cycles, self edges, cross-goal/unprovided citations, missing concept coverage, out-of-order prerequisites (same-step dependency is invalid), no concrete practice or check. Bound all text/arrays; return validated payload. Schema uses strict object fields, all required, additionalProperties:false. No auto repair/summarize/truncate of malformed model output.

Plans are immutable snapshots {id,goalId,revision,status:AI_GENERATED_UNVERIFIED,grounding:MODEL_ONLY or PINNED_SOURCES,provider:{id,model,mode},promptVersion,createdAt,sourceManifest:[{id,contentHash,provenance,observedAt}],payload,payloadHash}. Canonical recursively sorted JSON UTF8 SHA256 covers complete payload. New generate call creates NEW id/revision (transaction assigns per-goal sequence; no overwrite). Source selection explicit ids max8 (empty selects up to8 deterministically from this goal). Recheck source pins after provider await. Immutable DB insert-only for plans/sources. Unknown/cross-goal IDs fail before model call. No network await inside transaction. Model failure/invalid output => no partial plan/events. Unconfigured-provider request => no fake success.

Activities immutable per-plan/per-step with kind EXPOSURE/PRACTICE/REFLECTION, note <=4000, assisted:boolean. getProgress returns {activities,counts,mastery:UNPROVEN}; exposure, model output, self-report or assisted answers never grant mastery/Acceptance. ask returns/persists advisory answer {answer,sourceIds,limitations}, references only plan pinned sources, annotated AI_GENERATED_UNVERIFIED/provider mode; invalid output stores no answer. No automatic learned/mastered state or pCOS state mutation. SQLite events append alongside goal/source/plan/activity/answer write. Restart preserves IDs/hashes/history; no silent corrupt/schema reset.

OpenAIResponsesProvider exported from backend-providers.mjs implements optional real server-side POST https://api.openai.com/v1/responses with OPENAI_API_KEY and LEARNING_MODEL; fixed HTTPS provider endpoint, store:false, strict text.format json_schema, bounded max_output_tokens; accept only status completed and exactly one output_text with no refusal. NEVER claim every provider compatible. TavilySearchProvider optional fixed https://api.tavily.com/search bearer TAVILY_API_KEY, basic search max_results5. Both injectable fetch for deterministic protocol tests, validated configuration, AbortSignal bounded timeout, bounded response stream <=512KiB, redirect:error, no automatic retries; generic sanitized public errors no upstream body/key. No secrets persisted/exposed/logged. Tests simulate refusal/rate-limit/bad JSON/incomplete/timeout. Production missing config exposes capability unavailable, not fixture fallback.

Export createBackendServer({dbFile,modelProvider,searchProvider}) from backend-server.mjs returns unbound Node http.Server, server.backend.close() explicit; GET /api/v1/status ->{modelConfigured,searchConfigured,scope:LOCAL_SINGLE_USER}; GET/POST /api/v1/goals; GET /api/v1/goals/:id; GET/POST /api/v1/goals/:id/sources; POST /api/v1/goals/:id/search; GET/POST /api/v1/goals/:id/plans; GET /api/v1/plans/:id; POST /api/v1/plans/:id/activities; GET /api/v1/plans/:id/progress; POST /api/v1/plans/:id/ask. GET collections return arrays; mutations return created objects (201 or200). JSON body <=128KiB with strict content-type. GET/status/unknown never expose credentials or internal stack. Pin Host to127.0.0.1:<port>, reject cross-origin writes, no permissive CORS, OPTIONS denied. CLI port4174/--port0..65535/--db trusted argument; bind127.0.0.1 only. Single-user/local; no remote-auth claim. Global bounded concurrent provider jobs/busy response and no infinite queued requests; requests have bounded handling. CLI env construction reads keys only server side. Ignore .data and .env files.

Add meaningful tests in two new test files: actual SQLite reopen persistence/isolated goals/no partial invalid writes; schema cycles/unseen refs/incomplete plan; 3 disciplines passed to recording test provider and distinct test fixtures explicitly NOT quality proof; genuine HTTP model missing503/goal/sources/plans/activities/ask/Host+Origin rejection/bad body; injected HTTP protocol provider tests including failures. Tests use inside-workspace mkdtemp+cleanup, no child process/network except local loopback HTTP. Document exact API examples/model setup, keys never in browser; proven vs unproven including no live-model quality proof, no multi-user auth, no full internet corpus. README distinguish legacy demo vs new backend. Do not change immutable previous contracts or pCOS architecture.

research.fact: Responses uses text.format with type json_schema, name/schema/strict; required fields and additionalProperties:false. Structured shape is not proof of factual correctness.
POST /search bearer authorization, query, search_depth basic and max_results; snippets are observations not automatically verified facts.
DatabaseSync supports file SQLite and prepared statements; node:sqlite introduced22.5; busy_timeout must precede lock-taking initialization.
OATutor associates knowledge components with practice and evaluates heuristics; retain observation distinction, do not copy mastery probabilities or assume efficacy.
